attributes.axis_log: Re-derived baseline: T419/O421, real 306, multiset 30t, frame 144/144, SLOT MAP IDENTICAL. The 2 surplus instructions are one cluster, and the aligned view at @5cc-5e0 names it exactly. Target: lwz r0,sLastPlayerStart / li r21,0 / cmpwi r0,0 / mulli r0,r21,12 -- the load AND the compare are both DEAD (r0 is overwritten by the mulli and no branch reads cr0), while the guard's branch and body are gone. Ours emits the same first three instructions and then bge->5e0 / li r22,0, the branch plus a redundant re-zeroing of a variable already zero. So the original source states a guard that MWCC's later passes reduced to nothing but whose comparison was already emitted; two source shapes were tried to reproduce that and both failed in informative ways. Probe 1 establishes a general rule, confirmed independently on LinkItemTriggers in the same session and banked as claim.law.IT_empty-bodied-if-elides-its-own-comparison.20260901.v1: an empty-bodied `if` is elided WHOLE by the MWCC front end, so it is never the lever for a dead compare. Probe 2 refutes the natural reconstruction hypothesis that the tautological `selected = 0;` standing immediately before the guard is the artifact -- moving that initialization to the declaration neither removed the redundant conditional store nor the branch, and cost 146 points of `real` in allocator cascade. Two distinct axes, both negative with the failure cause understood, so this cluster is capped rather than iterated further.
